scope: Cross-directory external references and same-name resource stream isolation

reproduced: Basename-only dependency queue skips another directory's shared.assets.
Same-name standalone SerializedFiles cannot be resolved to their owning directory.
A warmed shared.resS cache returns the first directory's bytes for another directory.
Missing local targets can bind a foreign unique name; ambiguous descendants are guessed.

fixes: Queue disk dependencies by full path and resolve explicit local paths before unique recursive matches.
Resolve PPtr using exact loaded identity, owner directory or owning container; do not use a global basename fallback.
Invalidate resolved-reference caches when the loaded-file set grows.
Cache disk streams by full path and memory streams by source container plus resource name.
Preserve source-qualified resource enumeration without duplicating QTS container rows.
Reject ambiguous resource aliases instead of choosing the first reader.
PPtr.Set distinguishes same-basename files using actual SerializedFile identity.
fixturePolicy: Synthetic files are generated under .cache; no game data or binary dependencies are committed.
distribution: This source PR does not replace previously packaged ZIP or Setup files.
